Its channels are the three first-party pages a reader can watch: the API catalog, the changelog, and the Creator Hub blog. The San Francisco entity, its notice address, and its venture backing are facts about where the company is incorporated and financed, not about where the product is built, and the record keeps the two apart.

labs.organization_note: Xiaomi Corporation, incorporated in the Cayman Islands and listed in Hong Kong, gives its address at the Xiaomi Campus on Anningzhuang Road, Haidian District, Beijing, which its annual report names as its head office and principal place of business in the Chinese Mainland. It develops the Xiaomi MiMo models and publishes them under the XiaomiMiMo organizations. One name, Xiaomi, covers the models in the catalog.

evidence.label: Investor relations contacts giving the Xiaomi Campus address in Haidian District, Beijing
Xiaomi Corporation 2025 annual report: incorporated in the Cayman Islands with limited liability
MiMo repository licence: copyright Xiaomi Corporation

labs.name: Z.ai
labs.description: The AI company, known in China as Zhipu, that develops the GLM models and builds the Z.ai assistant, ZCode, and the Z.ai and BigModel APIs on them.
labs.organization_note: Beijing Zhipu Huazhang Technology (北京智谱华章科技股份有限公司), which its site calls Beijing Knowledge Atlas Technology Joint Stock Company Limited and gives an address in Haidian District, Beijing, develops the GLM models and operates the Zhipu AI Open Platform (BigModel) in China, while the international Z.ai Model API is contracted through JINGSHENG HENGXING TECHNOLOGY PTE.LTD under terms governed by Singapore law. The catalog uses the brand and both entity names, so all three belong to this record.
